armLipo.heroDesc: Stubborn upper arm fat around triceps, inner arms, or armpits often won't respond to diet or exercise. Arm liposuction removes localized fat, refines your arm shape, and creates smooth, natural-looking contours. Performed by Dr. Soma, a board-certified plastic surgeon using advanced techniques for better definition with minimal trauma.
armLipo.whatDesc: Arm liposuction is a surgical procedure that removes excess subcutaneous fat from the upper arms using small, hidden incisions. It targets areas that commonly create the "bat wing" appearance or cause arms to look bulky in fitted clothing.
armLipo.area1Desc: Reduces fullness and improves slim appearance.
armLipo.area3Desc: Improves arm shape and sleeve fit.
armLipo.area4Desc: Smooths bulges near the axillary fold.
armLipo.techDesc: Dr. Soma selects the specific method based on your fat volume and skin elasticity.
armLipo.palDesc: Power-Assisted Liposuction uses rapid vibration to break up fat cells uniformly.
armLipo.miniDesc: For slim patients who have small, stubborn pockets of fat.
armLipo.adjDesc: Blending contour with nearby areas for a seamless silhouette.
armLipo.compareDesc: Understanding the difference between fat removal and skin removal is crucial for the best outcome.
armLipo.tableFooter: Recommended procedure depends on your skin elasticity
armLipo.drNoteText: If you have significant loose, hanging skin (excess laxity), liposuction alone may not be enough. An Arm Lift might be required.
armLipo.ideal4Text: Non-smoker or willing to stop temporarily.
armLipo.notSuitable1: Significant loose hanging skin is the main issue.
armLipo.notSuitable3: Poor skin elasticity (skin may not retract).

armLipo.recDesc5: Full tissue tightening. Final definition revealed.

armLipo.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about arm liposuction
armLipo.faq1A: Arm liposuction is a surgical procedure that removes excess subcutaneous fat from the upper arms to improve contour and definition.
armLipo.faq2A: Small incisions are made, a fine cannula is inserted, and fat is removed using tumescent technique and MicroAire Power-Assisted Liposuction to support smoother results.
armLipo.faq3Q: When will I see results after arm liposuction?
armLipo.faq3A: You will notice gradual improvement as swelling reduces. Many patients see visible changes at 4–6 weeks, with final results around 3–6 months.
armLipo.faq4Q: How long do arm liposuction results last?
armLipo.faq4A: Results are long-lasting because removed fat cells do not regenerate. Maintaining stable weight preserves contour.
armLipo.faq5Q: Does arm liposuction tighten loose skin?
armLipo.faq5A: It can provide mild tightening if your skin elasticity is good. If loose hanging skin is significant, an arm lift may be recommended.
armLipo.faq6A: Discomfort is usually mild to moderate and is well managed with medication. Most patients describe soreness rather than sharp pain.
armLipo.faq7Q: How long is downtime after arm liposuction?
armLipo.faq7A: Most patients return to desk work within 5–7 days. Exercise is typically resumed around 4–6 weeks with surgeon approval.
armLipo.faq8A: Scars are minimal because incisions are small and placed discreetly. They fade significantly over time.
armLipo.faq9A: When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a proper medical facility, arm liposuction is generally safe. Risks exist like any surgery and are discussed during consultation.
armLipo.faq10Q: How many areas can be treated in one session?
armLipo.faq10A: Many patients treat both arms in a single procedure. Adjacent contouring areas may be added depending on safety and surgical planning.
armLipo.harvardDesc: Liposuction can safely remove localized fat when performed by qualified surgeons.
armLipo.mayoDesc: Explains that fat cells are removed from targeted areas and results are maintained with a stable lifestyle.
armLipo.pubmedDesc: Clinical literature confirms Power-Assisted Liposuction (PAL) improves efficiency and contour smoothness.
armLipo.ctaDesc: Dr. Soma combines precision contouring, advanced MicroAire PAL technology, and safety-first technique to deliver natural, long-lasting arm refinement.
